reviews.text: Andrea took such good care of our little Fish. Cleaned his ears, gave him a bath, and made him look handsome. The Polaroid and bandana were perfect little touches. We will be back!
Andrea is absolutely wonderful. My dog is very anxious and he is always cooperative with her and looks perfect after each grooming.
We see Stan at the Lakeview location and he is the BEST! All of the staff is so friendly and caring with the dogs, and they give the cutest goody bag after. Best cut in the city by far!
We always have such a great experience here. Our pup has been coming here for the past 3 years and he always looks adorable :) we recently got his haircut with Maya and we love it!
Have been using dashing dog for about 3 years and my golden retriever always looks great! Meghan does an awesome job!
Maya did a wonderful job! My dog always looks great!

Jimmy at Dashing Dog Groomer was absolutely wonderful with my dog Andy! He took such great care of him and made sure he was comfortable throughout the whole grooming. Andy came home looking adorable, smelling fantastic, and so clean and fluffy! Highly recommend! 🐾❤️
Charlotte did a phenomenal job on Archie and everyone at Dashing Dog is always delightful to deal with. Will definitely keep coming back.
Jimmy and the team st Dashing Dog did a fantastic job! They took great care of my dog today. Already booked the next visit.

Jimmy and Charlotte groomed my two dogs (one of which was her first time) and they handled them with such great care!! They followed my wishes for the grooming and they look amazing. Will definitely be back!
Thank you Stan and the rest of the staff!! Would highly recommend. They are quick and detailed and went the extra mile for our dog.
Charllote at the Lakeview location took such good care of my 10 month old puppy during her first groom! Def will go back.
Philip did a great job with my puppy, Frank. It was his first groom, and he looks amazing. We’ll be back!

sent my miniature schnauzer here, just an anxious boy, and he was greeted with so much kindness it was amazing! his groom is perfect, no notes Franco, no notes, and he left in such a great mood. loved the Polaroid I got of him too!! cannot recommend this place enough :)
Jenifer did amazing on my Pomeranian! Highly recommend 🙂

They took awesome care of my Smokey and his haircut was perfect! Great price too!  They are also always really quick which I appreciate given Smokey is an older dog. The little photos they give out at the end are adorable- I love them so much and keep them all. Today was with Maya and he is perfect! He has seen other groomers there as well and all are terrific
Listened to what I wanted and they pay attention to my instructions and was really nice and I would use him again and dashing dog

Unbelievable experience for our 8-month old Golden Retriever Puppy Walter!! The team at Dashing Dog did an amazing job and we were very happy about his first visit to the groomers. We will definitely be going back!!

We moved to Chicago a few months ago and were nervous about finding a new groomer. Dashing Dog has been amazing from the start. Listen to exactly what you want, finish in a timely manner, and the groom is always fantastic. Logan in particular has done a great job on my girl. Reasonable prices for what you get and they always send you home with a picture and a cute new toy!
Franco did an absolutely amazing job on our sheepadoodle, Dewey! It was his first ever groom and they were so gentle and patient with him!!! He looks cute as a button.

Highly recommend for doodle owners. I love this grooming spot. Decided to leave a review due to my most recent experience. I've never had a groomers that actually took time and care into doing a good job on your dog. As a doodle owner of 2, I was used to to the constant routine from my previous groomers of taking my dogs in only to get them shaved down to the skin due to "matting". The only times that this has happened at Dashing Dog were either because I've requested it, or because there really is matting and I am fully aware that it's the only option. During my most recent visit, quite a bit of time had lapsed since her last appointment since she was recovering from an injury so I expected them to not be able to save anything but she came out extremely poofy, de-matted and beautiful.

I took my dog Bianca for the first time today since I moved to Chicago and Jimmy the groomer did an amazing job with her!
He was also very kind and gentle with her and after I picked her up she seemed very happy and content!
Andrea did a great job with our Bernedoodle. He had a full groom and looked great when we picked him up, and seemed very comfortable there. Will definitely be back!
Ray did a wonderful job with Addilynn and Edward! Staff are always super friendly and I like that I can call and sometime get a same day appointment and usually always the next day.
Boogie looks great thanks to Jimmy. Would recommend
My puppies first groom and he looked and smelled amazing. Stanley did amazing and we’ll be back

Jimmy provided a fantastic bath and puppy cut to our 4 month old labradoodle. He spent time speaking with my partner and I pre and post grooming, which made us feel very comfortable leaving our girl in his care (and she loved him)! The customer service at Dashing Dog was excellent! I love how they also gave a polaroid pic and toy as a take home gift.
Emiliia did such a great job on my boy, Harvey! He was badly matted but they were still able to keep some fluff to my baby! I’m so happy with the work—give em a raise!
All of the staff in Dashing Dog truly care about every pet, just as if it's their own. My Evee loves seeing all of her neighborhood pup pals here 💕

I’m not sure why there are so many good reviews. We brought our 10-lb dog to be groomed (hair dog) and they charged us almost 50 percent more than the full service fee for dematting (20 dollars more) and “complex” (another 20 dollars more) whatever that means. With tip, we paid 140 dollars, which is more than I pay for my own haircut (including tip). I have brought her to other groomers in the city and we never paid more than $100, even if she had extra matting. They also didn’t provide her water, when I got back home, she drank a whole bowl.

The groom itself was okay but the price gouging and the lack of water / care make this a non starter going forward. Would avoid if you have a hair dog. Maybe they do better with brush outs on dogs that shed. Not sure what else could be driving the good reviews.
Our first experience of grooming ever turned out to be the best. Andrea was so professional, patient and friendly with our puppy.
Felix did a wonderful job with my puppy I was very happy with the service he provided that day...Happy first time customer

took my standard poodle there yesterday for a complex haircut, his groomer, franco, spent nearly four hours working on every single meticulous detail on my dogs coat. he looked absolutely stunning when he was done. on the way home alone he, my dog, got 6 separate compliments on how good he looked. i cannot reccomend people go anywhere other than here, the groomers obviously care about every single dog they see and you can see it in their work.

I took my dog to get groomed the other day after bringing her here to Chicago. She’s usually very anxious at grooming appointments, especially somewhere new. However when I picked her up, I could tell she was calm and comfortable waiting for me. Franco was kind and did a wonderful job with her haircut! He also asked about any notes or requests I had at the beginning of the appointment. Happy and relieved with how everything turned out and would definitely recommend. Thank you!
Stanley did a wonderful job with our cockapoo’s summer cut! Highly recommend!
Our Newfoundland girl Phoebe had a dashing first spa day at Dashing Dog Lakeview! Thanks to Meaghan for taking care of our pup so amazingly.
Cosmo has his sexy on again thanks to Andrea at Dashing Dog! He’s a finicky client but Dashing Dog always handles him well. Thanks for the spa day Andrea!
We saw Maya! I have a mini poodle and she did a great job

Update: After a year + of coming to visit with Miss Waffles, we had a really bad experience. When I came to grab her, while finishing up the neckline, the groomer was REALLY rough with her. My heart actually sank. He was grabbing her chin very hard to hold her still to get an even cut. And while I understand she may need to look up he was shoving her body around and she was clearly frustrated. I almost went back immediately to say she was done. By no means was an even cut on the neck worth that. A treat would’ve made that move just fine for her. I was extremely uneasy coming home to then find her foot bleeding profusely all over the backseat of the car and into the house. Her quick had clearly been cut. While I understand accidents happen, I would’ve liked to have been notified besides the panic of a LOT of blood all over her back white paw. Honestly, I can overlook the nail mistake but the rough housing with her has me feeling awful I brought her in. I understand after 3 hours she may be tiring but I need to find a new groomer now that works with more positive reinforcement and treats to get her into the right positions.

Trey did an amazing job grooming my 110lb Bernese Mountain Dog. I was nervous as this was our first time at a new place and she can be anxious around the clippers but she had a wonderful experience and looked great! They listened to exactly what I wanted completed, and the pricing was great. Can’t wait to bring her back in the future!

Maya did an absolutely amazing job with my baby girl. The front desk took great notes of what I wanted and Maya followed them exactly. I mentioned her 1st bday was this weekend and they even gave her a mini bday photoshoot. Everyone was pleasant and the service was quick!

Updated.... review... The first visit seemed promising since this groomer came highly recommended. Unfortunately, my dog's ear was cut quite badly during grooming and was bleeding afterward. I understand that accidents can happen, so I decided to give them another chance.

During the second visit, I saw firsthand how my dog was being treated, and I was shocked. The groomer was jerking him around, pulling his leg, and handling him aggressively throughout the grooming. No dog deserves to be treated that way.

To make matters worse, when the groomer brought him back, he said, "Here it is – old dog." That comment was disrespectful and completely unprofessional.

I am simply disgusted by this place. I cannot recommend it to anyone who wants their pet to be treated with kindness, patience, and respect.

P.S. Thank you for your reply. I would genuinely like to see the video that you say shows no evidence of my dog being mistreated.

I was there, watching through the glass. I know what I saw. What I witnessed was not simply handling a dog who was unable to stay still. It was rough, unnecessary, and aggressive pulling of his legs.

I stand by what I witnessed, and I hope other pet owners who bring their dogs here have a very different experience. Good luck to everyone.
My dog was taken promptly as a walk in nail trim with Andrea. She. Did an excellent job
Philip did a great job grooming my sweet girl! He gave her the cutest cut around the face! Love dashing dog grooming- consistently great and never takes more than 2hrs! 😊
Andres did a fantastic job on our guy today, we’ll be back!
Franco was awesome! Great cut!
They did a great job!!
Phillip did an amazing job with my guy!!

Took my dog here for the first time today, and they were so great with her! She’s a little nervous at the groomer but she was so happy with her haircut, as am I! Franco did an amazing job with her! Prices are a little on the expensive side, but you get a little goody bag after your service so it was worth it for me. Can’t wait to bring her back!

Monroe had the pleasure of being groomed by Andres today and he did a fantastic job! As soon as I walked in, he introduced himself and had the warmest smile which made me feel safe to leave my first puppy in his hands. All of my requests were satisfied and I will definitely be back!
Maya does a great job! Also love how communicative the business is, & the ease of scheduling.

Lenny has been going to Dashing Dog for a while now and they always do such a great job. Maya recently groomed Lenny and he came back looking handsome, clean, and exactly as I asked. He’s a bit nervous to get groomed but I always feel comfortable leaving him in their hands. Thanks Maya!

Ray did a fantastic job with my 5-month-old puppy's very first grooming appointment! My pup was pretty nervous, but I knew he was in great hands with everyone at Dashing Dog. He even came home with a welcome gift and an adorable Polaroid picture. I really appreciated those thoughtful little touches! We'll definitely be back to see Ray again.
Ava always has a great experience at Dashing Dog with groomer Jimmy! She looks great, smells great, and loves playing with the complimentary toy that they hand out! Highly recommend!
We love the Dashing Dog! Jimmy did a great job with Archie today. We have been loyal customers for over a year and never a complaint. Highly recommend!
Great grooming by Jimmy!
Phillip was fantastic with our 5-month old Mini Aussie Labradoodle. He was patient with her wiggling and groomed her exactly like we discussed. Highly recommend!

I want to compliment both Emilia and Stanley,  who have recently groomed my precious miniature schnauzer. Not only did Zelig look incredibly cute after his day of beauty, but he was happy and stress-free. I'll be making future appointments with these professionals at Dashing Dog.
Ray and team was amazing with my mini dachshund! She came back smelling fresh and Ray was so quick and friendly with my girl❤️❤️great team highly recommend!

I just moved to Chicago and was nervous trying out a new groomer for my Yorkie, but this place was amazing and I'm so relieved! The customer service was wonderful when dropping my pup off for his appointment, and Andrea did a great job with his cut and groom. They also left us with a new dog toy and a photo of him which I thought was such a sweet touch. 10/10 recommend!
Overall great grooming and deshedding appointment for our Shiba. They even sent us home with a small gift bag which included a toy and Polaroid photo of our dog. Would recommend Phillip :)
This was my dog's,Elsa, first visit to Dashing Dog.Philip did an excellent job with her bath,groom, and overall care of Elsa. I will highly recommend this location and Philip for future needs

My dog has been to dashing dog twice. While he looked handsome, they didn’t listen to our requests. Twice. I had told them I wanted his hair short and specifically said 1inch based on their hair length chart. We picked him up after he spent 3-4 hours there and had to take him back each time for more trimming because they didn’t do what we asked. Even after waiting an additional 45min he was still not the length we requested. Seems like if you spend over $200, they would do what you ask.
Milo looks amazing and is skipping around with a spring in his step thanks to Jimmy!!

Franco did an amazing job and everyone at dashing Dog was so helpful. They were able to get my dog in quickly for a grooming appointment and also sent us home with this cute photo and a toy. I also appreciated that they understood the different doodle hair lengths and did not poodle my doodle. Overall, highly recommend.

Pam did a wonderful job grooming our standard poodle! He came in with mats on his face (bc he hates being brushed and has a dense coat) and she got them out along with a lovely bath and cut in no time. It was the fastest cut we’ve had and was reasonably priced. We went to another place nearby and it was $320 including tip, and this place was $183. Couldn’t recommend more, thank you Pam!

Stanley did an amazing job with Maxi! He was so kind and caring, and Maxi looked absolutely adorable after his grooming. We even drove from La Porte, Indiana, and it was 100% worth the trip. We’ll definitely be back. Thank you, Stanley! 🐶💙
Great job we will be sending Willie you from now on

Dashing Dog at Lakeview east is an amazing place and Franco my dog’s groomer was amazing with my toy poodle. My dog came out looking happy and smiling :) Thankyou and I will definitely go back to them!
Good 👍 …
Got my dogs nails clipped! Andrea was amazing and made her feel very comfortable. I will definitely be going back
Trip was amazing with my pup!
stan did an amazing job with my bernese mountain dog today !!! he looks amazing and i couldn’t be happier. the entire staff was awesome too. our first time here but we will absolutely be back !
wouldn’t recommend for poodle/doodles. Multiple patchy areas/looks rushed.. quality doesn’t match the cost

We received a full service grooming for our miniature schnauzer from Maya. The prices were extremely competitive and we received a fantastic service from Maya as well as the business. We were sent home with a little goodie bag and our pup looks fantastic. We were honestly surprised at how good the price was given Chicago prices tend to be very high / substantially higher than areas around. We were overall very pleased.
Our bb is so handsome! Ferris is quite anxious at the Groomer and they took such good care of him! Thank you Cris from Dashing Dog 🤍🐩 …
It was our first time at Dashing Dog and Emilia did a great job! My dog looks and smells great! Will definitely go back!
Kevin was vacationing in Chicago and LOVED his Groomer Felix🐾❤️
Enzo loves coming here! Everyone is so nice
Maya did a great job! Our dog gizmo looks so much better.
Only groomer I will come back to and make the haul across the city for.  Andrea made our dog look so good.  Thank you!
Dont relay on thier online appointment its not up to date not reliable. Just call to secure spot.
Brenda was our groomer today who took great care of our very anxious Australian shepherd. She gave her a great haircut and is looking great for summer!

I had a wonderful experience bringing my baby here for a bath and spot trim! I have an anxious little terrier who dreads getting groomed, but Ray did such a great job with him. I especially loved the nice touches like the Polaroid and toy they gave us on the way out :) I’ve definitely found my new groomer!
Brenda did a great job working with our anxious pup.

I’ve been trying different groomers for my dog and Dashing Dog is the first I’ve truly loved. Sunny came home groomed and cleaned up but still looked like herself, so thank you thank you Brenda!! They were quick, provided updates, and had so many times available when I went to book.

I specifically booked a sanitary trim in April, but when I took my dog to a new groomer a month later, they found significant matting in that area and indicated the trim either hadn’t been done properly or thoroughly. My dog had also started licking the area more than usual. Additionally, there was confusion at pickup and they initially brought out the wrong dog. Disappointed, as this hasn’t been an issue for my dog after prior grooms.

Today was my first time visiting Dashing Dog and I had a wonderful experience. I have two Shih Tzu’s one always a little nervous but she came back playful and jumping and the other one is just laid back. They looked and smelled absolutely beautiful !Phillip is the best.!!!
I would highly recommend Dashing Dog
I tried other the places and a little disappointed, but here I was totally pleased.

I always take my dog here and have had such a pleasant experience! I always feel like he’s is in good hands when I drop him off and his appointments are never more than an hour. They also take a cute photo and gift a dog toy, which is super sweet! Felix did an amazing job today!!

Second time it’s taken my pug over 2 hours to get a simple bath package done. We arrived for our 9am appointment, there were four other dogs waiting to be checked in and seemed like the receptionist was the only staff there. Staff are friendly and they seem to do a good job but they really need to figure out their scheduling.
Emilia did a great job with our dog Rani. The haircut style and length were exactly what we hoped for and looks great

Ollie had a wonderful groom with Phillip today at Dashing Dog in Lakeview! He took great care of him and Phillip’s attention to detail was spectacular. Ollie looks like a show dog! I will 100% go back.
We had a great experience at Dashing Dog. Our groomer, Phillip, did an amazing job! We would definitely recommend him to anyone looking for a groomer in the area.

We had such a great first experience at Dashing Dog!! Stan was my dog’s groomer and was exceptional with Kuma. 10/10 would highly recommend! My dog was calm, clean, and fresh when he came out. He’s a double-coated large dog so he needed deshedding and doesn’t love his rear being brushed, so I was extra impressed with the result our groomer got. With a cute bandana and a Polaroid given at the end, our experience overall was great. We’ll be back!
Fantastic service for my Pomeranian bichon mix! She seems happy after her haircut. Looks fantastic

We had a terrific experience taking our Longhair miniature dachshund here. The groomers were ver welcoming and friendly. We felt our groomer, Jen, did an excellent job with shaping and trimming our dogs hair. Would highly recommend to anyone looking to get their dog groomed.

Our 3 year old dog was recently diagnosed with late-stage cancer. He’s so fragile that we were hesitant to groom him but his nails got so long that we took him to dashing dog. The manager not only did an amazing job with his nails but also did an extremely efficient groom to clean Jax up. He looks so much better and we feel so much better knowing he is more comfortable. The manager and staff were so extremely kind and human in helping us through this tough time. I cannot recommend this business enough. Thank you! Look at for a blonde groomer with pink highlights. She is the manager- extremely skilled groomer and overall wonderful person.

Been taking Lucie to Dashing Dog since she was old enough to be groomed! She is very nervous about being groomed but they have always been very patient and loving toward her. Everyone she's been with does a wonderful job with her, though Lucie especially enjoys Andrea! We always have fun with the new toy after too!

This was our third time at Dashing Dogs Lakeview. I really loved the second haircut so I requested to have the same person this time. Franco did an amazing  job once again. Not only is the haircut perfect, he somehow manages to finish it in less than an hour and a half. He is going to be our regular groomer from now on. I also love the  themed photos and my dog Bronx loves the toys that we get sent home with. I definitely recommend this place and don’t be afraid to ask for a specific groomer if you think they did a great job!

My two doodles were beautifully groomed! Thank you to Franco and Felix. Dashing Dog was very efficient and created a welcoming environment for my dogs. Also a perk to receive a picture and goodie bag after!
Emilia did a great job with my rescue pup who had never been groomed before! Easy viewing area and process. I recommend!

We love Dashing Dog! They do great with our big, floofy Bernese Mountain Dog, she always comes back so clean and with a nice basic little trim even though we are just getting a bath. They’ve always been on time and prompt with getting her in and out too. Definitely recommend!

Such a great job! Blue is a 5 month old labradoodle and this was his first time going to the groomers and i was nervous about him not having a good experience but they said he did a great job! the entire place is super cute and cozy, which made me feel like that helped him be more comfortable. All the staff were extremely welcoming and asked me how i wanted Blue to be cut. He got the full grooming service oh wash, cut, blow dry, ear cleaning, and nail trimming. He came out PERFECT, his groomer Franco nailed it when i asked for a puppy cut with a light trim and cleaning up the face, definitely recommend him for doodles. They even give you a printed out photo, bandana, and toy after every service. In total before tip was $128, on the pricey side but totally worth it knowing they took great care of him, he was comfortable, he came out perfect, and they gave us the toy and bandana. For reference there’s a before picture.

We took our mini austrialian shepherd in for a full grooming and haircut and Brenda did fantastic! He came back so fluffy and clean. The entire staff are super great, highly recommend getting your grooming services done here. :)
Great service and staff! Very professional! Groomer Stanley did an amazing job!

I took my dog Nacho here for his first apt with Phillip today & im so glad I finally found a good groomer!! He’s a mini golden doodle who’s super anxious, and he was his normal self when I picked him up!! Nacho looks amazing and they even give you a Polaroid & a mystery toy after each appointment. The desk staff was just as amazing - I have no notes other than take your puppers here!!

My pup left Dashing Dog looking and feeling his best! Franco did a wonderful job bathing and grooming my Labrador/Great Pyrenees.
DD was our fav spot when we lived in the neighborhood. After we moved further away we couldn’t find a groomer that compared so now we are back. Friendly staff, easy to schedule.

Stan did a great job with our dog. Took great care of her.

Never seen our dog's hair this soft and fluffy!
Phillip - you do NOT disappoint ✨ we have taken our Bernese three times already and you nail it every time. Thank you for taking such great care of Teddy!
Franco did an amazing job grooming my dog Fisher. He looks adorable. He came back so happy and I really appreciate Franco! Thank you, thank you!
they gave my cats a bath today and were so sweet and my cats are so soft and they smell so good it was so nice to trust that they were in good hands!

We took our four month old puppy to dashing dog in Lakeview for her very first grooming and we are super happy with the way she was treated and the overall results. Our groomer was very sweet and patient with her. We were nervous taking her there as she is a very high energy puppy, but they were able to do everything in the grooming process on her! We signed up for a membership and will continue to be back!

This was my dog's first grooming experience, and considering her fear and anxiety, I was hoping for a very gentle and careful approach. I stayed the entire time and watched the process
Unfortunately, I didn't like how my dog was washed and dried - it felt rough and not very careful, and in my opinion, my dog was quite frightened. Even though the groomer tried and did everything she could given the situation, the overall process was still stressful for my pet.
Another unpleasant moment was being charged an additional $20 without prior notice, even though when booking on the website I originally selected the correct service package with no extra fees.
would like to especially highlight the groomer, Andrea - I highly recommend her. I really liked her approach. Despite how difficult it was due to my dog's fear, she treated her very gently, patiently, and with great care. It was clear that she was doing her best not to cause harm, taking her time and handling my dog with kindness and understanding.
Thanks to her, the overall impression was not completely negative - 1 am truly grateful for her attitude and effort.
Overall, the experience was mixed: there were positives, but also important areas that could be improved, especially gentle handling and price transparency.
They are attentive and caring. My dog and my grandma's dog both have had wondthair cuts from here.
Very happy with the past two grooms at Dashing Dog! They are super patient with my anxious doodle and he always looks great! They make booking super easy and simple. Highly recommend!

I had such a great experience at Dashing Dog! They were incredibly professional, friendly, and patient with my dog. The grooming was thorough, and my pup came out looking and smelling amazing. I appreciated how they took the time to handle my dog gently and answered all my questions about care and maintenance. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a reliable and caring dog groomer!
Emilia, our groomer, and the whole team were excellent!
Maya did an amazing job with my boy Monty! The scheduling was very easy and flexible as well. Looking forward to booking his next grooming - thank you, Maya!
Poor front desk staff, high prices, and harsh cancellation fees. The groomers do good work but it’s not worth $100 per groom on a small dog. Would not recommend.

Update. After taking my dog here for two years. I asked for a second cancellation within 24 hours because my car broke down and I couldn’t make it. The appointment was made 48 hours before the appointment. Dashing dog was not understanding and required 50% of the fee so I ubered to the appointment. I don’t appreciate a non humane billing approach and will find somewhere else to go.

In general, the prices are also steep and they have an à la carte style menu (ie: they trim nails but leave them raw, nail grinding is extra)
Emiliia was great with our mini Goldendoodle Stark. It was his first time at the groomer and he came home looking better than ever. We highly recommend their grooming services for dogs of all sizes!
Trip to a great job with my dog! My dog was nervous but Trip did a great job, making him comfortable and giving him a bath very efficiently.

Lexi did an amazing job with my pup! Very thorough from check-in all the way to check out! We even got a cute photo and toy to take. We will for sure be back!! The woman at the front desk was also great! You can tell she genuinely cares for each pet!
Always a great experience. Highly recommend if you’re in the area. Super nice staff to humans and dogs alike! Haha

Stanley is the best!! This is the third time I’ve brought my dog to Dashing Dog and this has been my favorite cut so far. You can tell the attention to detail Stanley has. Definitely asking for Stanley next time my golden needs a bath/trim! I always love the extra touch of a Polaroid and dog toy they send you home with🥰 …

I really wanted to love this groomer—the staff are always friendly and welcoming. Unfortunately, my bernedoodle has come back from every appointment with a very short, uniform buzz cut (about 1/2-inch guard all over the face and body), even when I’ve specifically requested a longer, more natural teddy-bear style typical for Doodles. After several disappointing experiences, I finally decided to buy my own clippers and learn to groom at home to preserve the look I want for my dog. I wish they were more experienced with Doodle-specific cuts and listened more closely to the requested length/style.

Great place for grooming! From appointment reservation to communication about grooming style, reminder calls, and pickup, everything was so smooth and well organized. The staff was professional and clearly cared about getting every detail right. Highly recommend!

Brenda at Dashing Dog did an amazing job! Our dog, Cumin, came back looking cute, happy, and well cared for. It’s also super easy to get an appointment, which we love. The little extras like a toy and a Polaroid photo are such a fun touch. Highly recommend!
Very happy with my dog Oliver’s grooming.

Emilia is the absolute best. She spends so much time making Otto look perfect every time she grooms him. She is so kind and always wants to make sure she grooms the dogs exactly how she wants. She also is so sweet with Otto. She talks to him and bonds with him during the cut so he doesn’t get anxious. She is so accommodating and my dog absolutely loves her!! She’s the only groomer Otto has ever gone too! We love you Emilia!

Cristian handled my dog with the best care possible! Did a thorough job of grooming him while answering all the questions I had including letting me watch the process. Not an easy job brushing a malamute so shoutout to him for getting the job done! When we come back; we will be requesting him all the time.

Brenda and Stanley gave my Yorkiepoo and Morkie the best haircuts they’ve ever received! They made sure their coats, faces, and potty areas were all cleaned up but also managed to do a wonderful teddy bear cut on both. Could not recommend Brenda, Stanley or Dashing Dog anymoreN
Took my puppy for their first grooming. Love the cut, but more importantly my dog wasn’t stressed and enjoyed it. Charly did a great job.
Phillip did a great job on our Bernedoodle! Dashing dog is always the best and our pup Murray loves his visits there! The staff treats the dogs so well :)
Ray was great with Riley. Great service, great bath, and even came out and let me know how she did at her visit

We started bringing our pup to Dashing Dog a few months ago after our previous groomer moved away. We have been very impressed with the level of service at DD. It’s never been easier to schedule a grooming appointment (usually same week). We appreciate the wonderful job Brenda does. Be sure to request her if you and your dog are looking to have a great experience. Dashing Dog has certainly made a loyal customer and canine out of us.

We had such a great experience with Charly! She groomed our dog Pluto and did an amazing job - his haircut turned out perfect, and he looked so happy and comfortable afterward. We’ll definitely be coming back!
We love Andrea!! She does an amazing job and takes great care of Mookie! 🩵
Great service. My dog is usually very anxious and scared with the groomer, but Andrea did a great job with him and he came back to us looking great!

We brought our mini Aussie doodle here after switching from another groomer. She looks so cute and Pam did an amazing job with her even though she can be an anxious pup with grooming.  All the staff were nice and upfront about pricing, which was greatly appreciated!

Maya did a great job with my pup’s grooming! He goes to Dashing Dog every month and always comes out happy as can be, and looking and smelling wonderful.
We love Dashing Dog! Stanley did a great job with Henry and we will definitely keep going back!

I chose this place because it has countless 5-star reviews but my experience was not pleasant at all. I have a very friendly labrador that loves everyone, including vets and groomers.

I had an appointment at 10:15. When he was brought to the back, he was making these absolutely horrible sounds of distress. I decided to wait in the seating area until his bath was done. He continued making these sounds all the way until 11:09 when I finally went to the front desk to ask if his bath was almost done or if I should leave to maybe make my dog feel better. And that's when the receptionist told me THAT THEY HADN'T EVEN STARTED WASHING HIM YET.

We're almost an hour into our appointment and you haven't even started on my dog? And this dog has been to veterinary offices and animal hospitals and was happy every single visit. I had NEVER heard him sound so distressed to that extent. AND THEY LET HIM GO ON LIKE THIS FOR 55 MINUTES STRAIGHT just in his kennel with absolutely NO communication with me.

SO unbelievably unacceptable.

Also, my friend brought her mini bernedoodle for a grooming session here and she discovered a small cut on his paw afterwards!
Jenifer did an amazing job with Larry’s haircut!
Great experience, quick, easy, and dog loved it

Thank you Andrea!
It’s so important to have a vet and a groomer that knows your pet well.  I love Dashing Dog because they make a point to know my senior dog’s needs and try to make her experience the best possible.  I am so happy I found this salon in Lakeview, Chicago! ❤️
Great place for dog wash and grooming. Andrea is very good - very kind and treats my dog with gentle care and attention!

They did a fantastic job and gave the dogs some toys! They were indeed “dashing”. They were professional and for two dogs it was about 2 hours. Very reasonable. They also gave me adorable little printed pictures of them right after the cut.

Emilia was great with my toy Pomeranian. They always do great every time we go and they’re the sweetest staff. Highly recommend!

I love this groomer and am so glad it's in our neighborhood--each groomer is great and our last groomer Jenifer did a super job doing the full grim package on my havanese. I've made Dashing Dog our regular groomers and highly recommend.
Dashing Dog is great. Fernando did a great job.
We always have such a great experience at Dashing Dog. Our golden retriever loves his spa days there and Cristian does an awesome job. Can’t recommend them enough!

I’ve been going here for the past year and a half, and everyone always does such a great job.  This time, Franco was the groomer today and did such a fantastic job, Zeus looks amazing :) highly recommend Franco and Dashing Dog!

This was Henry’s first time at Dashing Dog, and we are so happy! Jennifer did an amazing job with Henry’s bath and trim. It was also incredibly quick and efficient. He’s so soft, clean, smells great and his cut was exactly what I wanted for my doodle boy! (IU bandana not included in the groom)

I’ve been taking my dog here for years now and they are great everytime! I love the polaroids after each groom, how kind the staff are and how well they take care of my boy. Can’t recommend this place enough
Andrea did a great job with my pup!

Stan at Dashing Dog is wonderful. We take our Toy Poodle to him regularly every 3–4 weeks. Beautiful experience as always

First time coming and we were very happy with the cut on our dog. Friendly service, reasonable prices and a nice location. Will be back.

Amazing place! Brenda took care of our mini Australian Sheperd Tony. He had scraggly hair everywhere and was due for a true grooming and it was a wonderful experience. She did such an amazing job and Tony came back looking so handsome (pictures below of before and after) with a cute bandana and photo and toy from them. They are all very sweet. Definitely recommend!! I promise he's happier than he looks in the photo just tired 🤣

I’ve been going to Dashing Dog for a little over two years, but after reading some of the recent bad reviews, I have to admit they’re spot on and reflect my own experience. Each visit seems to bring confusion or inconsistency with how my dog’s haircut is done, even though I request the same thing every time. I’ve even brought in pictures of previous cuts, yet they still haven’t been able to match them.

The last two visits have been disappointing, but this most recent one was the final straw. My dog’s ear was cut again to the point that there’s now a scab underneath. That’s completely unacceptable. I’ve called before and specifically asked that a certain stylist not groom my dog anymore, but it seems that request hasn’t been respected.

While I appreciate the small touches like the free toy they give after each visit, the quality of the grooming and the lack of consistency just don’t justify the price anymore. On top of that, the pricing has changed without notice. I was told it was due to an increase in shampoo and conditioner costs, which I understand, but as a regular customer, it would’ve been nice to have that communicated upfront.

At this point, I’ll be looking for another groomer who values consistency, transparency, and care as much as they do business.

I can’t say enough good things about Dashing Dog in Lakeview. The staff here are incredibly kind, professional, and genuinely care about every dog that walks through the door. My pup always comes back looking and smelling amazing, and it’s clear they take the time to make sure each dog feels comfortable and calm.

Scheduling is easy, prices are fair, and the quality of the grooming is top-tier. The team communicates well and always follows the notes I leave about trimming length and coat style. They even send your dog home with a cute bandana and a little treat bag, which is a great touch.

If you’re looking for a place that treats your dog like family and delivers consistent, high-quality grooming every time, Dashing Dog is it.
Jenifer did a fantastic job cutting our golden doodle. She really needed a trim and fully body cleanup and she came out looking fantastic

It was our first time here and we loved it! Oliver my yorkie came out so happy, the service was great, and Charly was his groomer, she did exactly how I asked and took care of him. We’ll definitely be coming back! Thank you!!!
Andrea was so kind to my job and gave her such a nice cut. I was really pleased with my whole experience.
Andrea did an excellent job. Luca looked great and smelled amazing. We will return and request Andrea!

Brenda was great with my sweet little lady. She's 12 yrs old and is my seizure assistance dog, so she gets a bit anxious and is never put in a kennel. After a less than stellar experience at Petsmart, a dear friend recommended Dashing Dog, and I had a doctor's appt right up the street. First let me say, the price comparison is by far better, the base price at "conveyor belt" locations stack the bath, on top of the cut (+$?) stack the nail grinding on top on the clip (+$) don't me wrong, they're quite upfront about it, I mean it's RIGHT IN FRONT OF US, but they're convenient, quick, and we're usually able to accomplish other things while our furry babies are getting groomed, because bigbox is generally located is well placed area for shopping (that's good marketing👍🏾). I went down the rabbit hole for years too, but after having my baby put into a kennel [conveyer belt groomer] after we dropped her off ON TIME for her appt, explained the situation to them (they agreed) they took her and said they were going to bathe her, only to receive a call 2 hrs later to be told, they couldn't retrieve her from the kennel because she'd become upset and they required my help to get her FROM said kennel. That's correct 2 hrs later and she hadn't been groomed AT ALL no bath even, we were told  the other to groomers left for the day, so he was all alone and was stuck working on two dogs and couldn't get to Brown Betty at her appt time. Alright when we arrived there were three people there working on dogs-- I was livid to say the least. Our experience at Dashing Dog was the exact opposite, we arrived early, calmed down, met Brenda, my fur baby was able to be held, no anxiety, go in easily while I signed the paperwork and it was like dropping her off to her first day of school with friends. I highly recommend going to Dashing Dog. Everything including the nail grinding the bath the cut the experience was worth the $85 and we received a little toy, and a picture. They are so kind, and treat each fur baby individually as if they are their own, this is our new home.

Got the full service, but they forgot to trim my dogs nails.

My husky is very anxious and is not a fan of the groomers, but they always do a great job with him.
I recently had him groomed while he was shedding his under coat which is an insane amount of hair! Emilia took her time making sure he looked perfect and getting all of the undercoat out and personally coming out to let me know how he did after. Highly recommend!

Maya was awesome ! I’m assuming very patient as well considering my guy is alittle nervous but he looks amazing and he also looked happy and at ease when I picked him up! Great service.

I've been going to Dashing Dog for about 2 years now, and they have always given my dog a great haircut, and me with a great experience! Raymond did a great job with my six month old puppy. She came out looking clean, fresh, and happy!

We appreciate that Stan is extremely meticulous and takes his time with Winnie. We also love that they provide a polaroid of your dog and a toy after each groom! We highly recommend Stan and Dashing Dog to other dog owners!
Jen did an incredible job and worked with our dog even when he was matted to make sure we didn’t have to go shorter.
Maya was great with my dog. Highly recommend

It was Max's 1st time getting groomed & he looks amazing!!! The staff are so friendly & really helped up pick out a hair cut that would suite him. Mostly definitely coming back. 🫶🏻 Thank you Maya …

Phillip did an amazing job with my dog! He did a great job grooming him and followed my directions perfectly. I would highly recommend and will be a repeat customer. I love the special touch of providing a polaroid!

They also let you watch your dog being groomed which was a really cute touch. Daisy got one of the best cuts she's ever gotten and she actually seemed to have enjoyed her experience! She didn't seem anxious at all when I picked her up which is a great sign for the care and gentleness their groomers take. It is also so adorable that they give you a little polaroid and "blind box" toy with every visit. Will definitely be back in the future!
Ozzie looks great!  Thanks to Stanley, Ozzie has his summer hair with a #5 cut and can now run free and be so much cooler in the heat!

We definitely recommend Maya and Stan at Dashing Dogs and look forward to our next visit.
They did a great job. Will continue to come back.

I had a bad experience with my previous groomer and was looking for something new. I found Dashing Dog which, ironically, is a block down from my office. Was really happy to find this place for girl but the prices have gone up and the quality of service has gone done. Warning that they will charge you for canceling an appointment but have no problem canceling on you the day of due to their own staffing issues.

Edited to add: They do not allow you to book a specific groomer (I absolutely would since of the things that appealed to me about this place was a groomer who used to take care of my previous dog at another facility), so I have no idea who "my groomer" was supposed to be. They should have a plan to cover appointments if a staff member can't come in but clearly they overbook themselves and can't fulfill promised services. I'd planned my entire day around getting my girl to this appointment, and their weekday times are not conducive to anyone who has to work, so their halfhearted attempt at rebooking us was a sorry attempt at an apology. Now my girl has to spend another week being uncomfortable in this heat while I find some place that treats their customers better.
